messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Seventh protocol. An outside signal answers its vocalizations. It does not use the creature's frequency alone: it relies on your heartbeat.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Something is speaking to the bond between you.

choices.label: I jam the signal before it takes control of the bond.
I request a spectral translation before any answer.
I let it listen to see whether it recognizes the call.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: The signal sends an image: an open corridor, outside air, then a silhouette waiting beyond the complex.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: For us, it may be an invitation or a trap. For the creature, it is already almost a place.

choices.label: I close the channel. It is not ready to believe this image.
I answer with a neutral signal, without lab coordinates.
I follow the image with it to discover what is calling.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: If this signal is asking for the creature, who has the right to answer: the laboratory, you, or the creature?

choices.label: The laboratory answers. Nobody leaves while the risk exists.
I answer with it, but without promising to hand it over.
It answers. If it came from somewhere, it deserves to know.
